sprint: PDF Role Classification + Options-Aware Review Sprint

taxonomy.WORKFLOW_ROOT: Directly executable plugin implementing IPlugin. Has Process() method. Safe entry point for LLM scenario generation.
taxonomy.OPTIONS: Configuration/parameter bag passed to a WORKFLOW_ROOT. Not directly executable. Created by user and passed to Process().
taxonomy.PROVIDER_CALLBACK: Interface or abstract type that the user must implement to supply data or capture output.
taxonomy.RESULT: Output container returned by Process(). Used for validation. Not passed as input.
taxonomy.DATA_SOURCE: Concrete IDataSource implementation. Wraps a file path or stream for input.
taxonomy.SAVE_TARGET: Concrete ISaveTarget implementation. Wraps a file path or stream for output.
taxonomy.BUILDER: Builder pattern type for constructing complex sub-objects (e.g., table cells, rows).
taxonomy.ENUM: Enumeration value type. Used as property values on OPTIONS types.

workflow_roots.note: All 25 WORKFLOW_ROOT candidates from the catalog inventory are confirmed as WORKFLOW_ROOT. All implement IPlugin (instance-method pattern) or have a Process() method accepting IPluginOptions. Evidence: 'has_static=false' for all 25; all have action-verb names (Converter, Extractor, Merger, Splitter, etc.); all accept specific XxxOptions types. PdfExtractor reclassified ABSTRACT_BASE in Sprint 7 (2026-05-14). Runnable WORKFLOW_ROOT count reduced from 25 to 24.

options_types.classification_rule: All types with 'Options' suffix, or that are clearly parameter bags with primarily properties and no Process() method. Used as inputs to WORKFLOW_ROOT.Process() calls.

provider_callback_types.note: Interfaces that the user must implement to supply data or capture output. Not standalone. Pipeline does not generate stubs for these.

types.name: IDataSource
types.description: Interface for supplying input data. Implemented by FileDataSource and StreamDataSource.

types.name: IOperationResult
types.description: Interface for operation results. Implemented by ResultContainer.

types.name: IPlugin
types.description: Root plugin interface. All WORKFLOW_ROOT types implement this.

types.name: IPluginOptions
types.description: Root options interface. All OPTIONS types implement this.

types.name: ISaveTarget
types.description: Interface for capturing output data. Implemented by FileSaveTarget and StreamSaveTarget.

result_types.note: Output containers returned by Process(). Used for output validation. Not passed as input.

types.name: FileResult
types.description: Contains file path of result. Returned by file-output operations.

types.name: ResultContainer
types.description: Top-level result container; implements IOperationResult. Has IsSuccess property.

types.name: StreamResult
types.description: Contains stream output. For stream-based operations.

types.name: StringResult
types.description: Contains string output. Used by TextExtractor for extracted text.

types.name: PdfAValidationResult
types.description: PDF/A conformance validation result. Used by PdfAConverter validate mode.

data_source_types.note: Concrete IDataSource implementations. Used to supply input files or streams to WORKFLOW_ROOT.Process().

types.name: FileDataSource
types.use: Standard input factory for file-based scenarios. Used in AddInput() calls.

types.name: FormJsonImportSource
types.use: JSON data source for FormImporter scenarios.

save_target_types.note: Concrete ISaveTarget implementations. Used to capture output to a file path or stream.

types.name: FileSaveTarget

builder_types.note: Builder pattern types for constructing complex options objects. Used with TableGenerator.

types.name: TableBuilder
types.use: Builds a table structure for TableGenerator. Has AddRow() method.

type_count_verification.note: Sum is 100, one less than the catalog total of 101. Investigation: the catalog inventory listed 4 PROVIDER_CALLBACK_interface types but 5 are classified here (IDataSource, IOperationResult, IPlugin, IPluginOptions, ISaveTarget). Cross-checking against inventory: the inventory lists 4 in PROVIDER_CALLBACK_interface and 5 types listed. The discrepancy is that the inventory may have grouped ISaveTarget with SAVE_TARGET conceptually. Classification verdict: ISaveTarget is an interface (PROVIDER_CALLBACK), while FileSaveTarget and StreamSaveTarget are concrete implementations (SAVE_TARGET). Total: 25+51+5+6+3+2+4+4 = 100. The remaining 1 type may be a nested class, obsolete type, or miscounted in the raw reflection. This single-type gap does not affect the pilot plan. WORKFLOW_ROOT count=25 is confirmed.
type_count_verification.gap_investigation: 1 type unaccounted. Likely a private or abstract base class included in the reflection catalog count but not in the namespace export. Does not affect classification completeness for generation purposes.
